registry_meta.name: GLOBAL_CINEMA_SOURCE_REGISTRY
registry_meta.purpose: Authoritative starting registry for legitimate free-to-watch cinema sources.
core_policy: Only a verified complete film with a current free legitimate source can be marked watchable.
Paid subscription, rental and purchase-only sources are excluded from WATCH.
Free viewing and third-party embedding are separate permissions.
If embedding is prohibited or unverified, use WATCH_FREE_EXTERNALLY.
Do not infer rights from presence on YouTube, Internet Archive, or any hosting platform.
Every playback source must store source owner, exact URL, free/full/official verification, embed status, territories, and last-checked time.

watch_states.WATCH_HERE: Free, legitimate, complete film and embedding is permitted.
watch_states.WATCH_FREE_EXTERNALLY: Free, legitimate, complete film but playback must remain on the source site or embed permission is unverified.
watch_states.NO_VERIFIED_FREE_STREAM: No current verified free full-film source.

sources.name: Library of Congress — National Screening Room
sources.notes: The Library says the majority of titles are freely available as MP4/ProRes downloads. Rights still require per-item review before rehosting or internal playback.

sources.name: National Film Board of Canada
sources.notes: NFB streams thousands free. Its current embed terms allow official embed code but restrict commercial use and require link-back.

sources.name: Mosfilm
sources.notes: Enumerate only Mosfilm-controlled full-film pages/channels; verify embed and territory per title.

sources.name: Korean Film Archive — Korean Classic Film
sources.notes: KOFA identifies about 190 Korean classics as free on official channels; verify each title and subtitle track.

sources.name: Danish Film Institute — Danish Silent Film
sources.notes: Important official early-cinema source. Audit current player/embed rules before internal playback.

sources.name: Cinémathèque française — HENRI
sources.notes: HENRI currently lists hundreds of rare films. Terms specify viewing through the Cinémathèque service. Availability may be temporary.

sources.name: Retina Latina
sources.region: Latin America / Caribbean; some worldwide titles
sources.notes: Retina Latina says its catalogue licenses do not permit third-party-platform distribution. Store per-title territory and expiry.

sources.name: Filmoteca UNAM — Cine en Línea
sources.notes: Official Mexican film-archive source. Verify title availability and embed policy individually.

sources.name: 35mm.online
sources.notes: Polish public sources describe nearly 4,000 digitized/reconstructed film materials. Enumerate complete films separately from other audiovisual material.

sources.name: BFI Player — Free / Archive Films
sources.notes: Import only titles explicitly marked Watch for free. Exclude BFI subscription/rental catalogue.

sources.name: Eye Film Player
sources.notes: Eye says the player contains many free films alongside rentals. Import only titles individually marked free.

sources.name: Swedish Film Institute — Cinemateket Play
sources.notes: Use the current Cinemateket Play service. Do not ingest retired Filmarkivet.se playback links.

sources.name: National Film Archive of Japan — Japanese Animated Film Classics
sources.notes: The archive explicitly prohibits embedding its videos on third-party sites. Link to official free playback only.

sources.name: NZ On Screen
sources.notes: Strictly filter to full free films. Exclude trailers/excerpts, TV-only records, and all paid NZOS+ rentals.

sources.name: Films Division / NFDC India — Video On Demand
sources.notes: Films Division holds 8,000+ works, but only currently working VOD/full-film titles may be counted as watchable.

rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.name: Saina Movies / Saina Infotainments
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.evidence: Saina says it holds copyrights to 700+ titles and operates Saina Movies, an official YouTube channel offering HD Malayalam films.
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.rule: Enumerate the official channel; verify full film, free access, embed flag and territory per video.

rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.name: AP International
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.evidence: AP International states it has acquired copyrights to 1,500+ movies.
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.rule: Discover its verified official free full-film outlets and import only specific complete free films.

rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.name: Angel Digital
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.evidence: Angel states it controls multiple rights for 1,000+ Bengali films.
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.rule: Do not assume the 1,000+ catalogue is free. Identify Angel-controlled free full-film outlets and verify titles individually.

rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.name: Shemaroo Entertainment
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.evidence: Shemaroo advertises a large licensed movie and non-movie catalogue.
rights_holder_channels_to_enumerate.rule: Only specific official free uploads may enter WATCH after channel ownership, full-film status and free access are verified.

metadata_sources.name: TMDB
metadata_sources.rule: Use only under applicable API/license/attribution terms. Never infer playback rights from TMDB.

metadata_sources.name: Wikidata / Wikimedia Commons
metadata_sources.rule: Check each media asset license. Never assume all posters are reusable.

metadata_sources.name: JFDB — Japanese Film Database
metadata_sources.rule: Reference/metadata only unless a separate legitimate free playback source exists.

never_auto_ingest_as_watchable: Random YouTube uploads from unverified channels
Piracy sites or unauthorized streaming mirrors
Random Internet Archive uploads merely because they are downloadable
Trailers, clips or excerpts presented as full films
Paid-only subscription, rental or purchase sources
hard_gate: No source becomes public until full_film_verified=true AND free_verified=true AND official_or_rights_verified=true AND the URL passes a live availability check.
implementation_order: Import this registry into the project as config/data, not hard-coded UI text.
Build the Source Registry and PlaybackSource data models.
Implement adapters for all P0 sources first, with no arbitrary title-count cap.
Enumerate every currently available film from each approved source.
Deduplicate the same film across providers into one canonical Work with multiple PlaybackSources.
Resolve real metadata and poster sources.
Verify free/full/official/embed/region status per playback source.
Populate the public catalogue from the verified database.
Continue through P1 and newly discovered official sources until the source sweep is exhausted.
Run recurring discovery and rechecks so new films appear automatically and expired/dead sources are downgraded automatically.
acceptance_tests: The catalogue is no longer a tiny hand-written seed array.
Watchable First never returns a film without a current verified free source.
WATCH HERE never appears unless embedding is actually permitted and working.
Free external sources appear as WATCH FREE EXTERNALLY.
Paid-only sources never appear in WATCH.
The same film from several sources appears once with several source options.
Counts come from database state, never hard-coded marketing numbers.
The initial sweep continues until every registered source is enumerated; it does not stop at 5k, 10k or 30k.
Newly discovered sources enter review before they can auto-publish films.
